items.text: A pane added to a covered or minimized window on Windows starts hidden and nothing in that window draws until it shows.
A divider drag or fold glide beside a viewer pane no longer stalls the terminals while the viewer resizes.
The pane-move trace names a viewer's own bounds sync apart from the OS move, and shows it is the glide's one slow pane move.
A stack strip's name is drawn once and laid from its picture, so a fold glide no longer puts out GDI text every frame.
